home.metaDescription: I build software products, lead the community around one of them, and keep everything I make as a single numbered archive.
home.statement: I build products, decide where they go, and imagine what surrounds them.
home.intro:
I am a product engineer working across the African tech ecosystem. Most of my work sits at the point where a product decision and a technical decision turn out to be the same decision, which is the part I find worth doing.

Over the past year that has meant a talent development platform running on four services, fourteen reference implementations for people learning to ship, and a governance layer that keeps the decisions behind all of it public.

BUILD.title: Build
BUILD.body: Rust, Python, TypeScript, Kotlin, Go. Backends that hold, mobile that works without a network, and interfaces that do not make their users work.

LEAD.title: Lead
LEAD.body: Product direction, written decisions, public changelogs, a code of conduct. Leading is mostly making the reasoning visible before the outcome is.

CREATE.title: Create
CREATE.body: Art direction, worldbuilding, interfaces built in a game engine because a list would not have been enough. The part that answers to nothing but the idea.

about.label: Who
about.body:
Based in Cotonou, Benin, working remote on GMT+1. Lead architect on a multi-tenant SaaS platform serving five live client tenants, technical director of a cultural product launching this quarter, and sole builder of Skilluv.

French is my first language, English my working one.

about.intro:
Full-stack engineer building production systems end to end. Architecture, backend, frontend, infrastructure, and the part where it actually ships.

I have a bias for real products over demonstrations, which is why most of what follows is running somewhere with users on it rather than sitting in a repository as a proof of concept.
